nodes.description: Newborn larvae that enter striated muscle force the infected myocyte to dedifferentiate, re-enter and then arrest the cell cycle, while satellite cells are activated; a collagen-walled "nurse cell" capsule forms around the larva. The myositis of this phase produces myalgia and raised muscle enzymes.
